The '''VT-49 Decimator''' was a heavily armed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that had gone through many revisions and modifications, making it one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] more feared Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warships]].

==History==
[[File:VT49DecimatorMultiAngleView-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|VT-49 multi-angle view]]
Decimators were used as either long-range reconnaissance units or [[Picket ship/Legends|picket ships]] stationed along the perimeter of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Navy/Legends|fleets]]. Vessels of this class were also used to break through enemy [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] to deploy raiding parties.

The command of a VT-49 was a point of pride and accomplishment for the middle ranks of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was usually seen as a stepping stone on the path towards command of a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]].

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="DST">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Rianna Saren]] stole a VT-49 from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] to [[Mission to Danuta|go]] to [[Danuta]].<ref name="Lethal Alliance">''[[Star Wars: Lethal Alliance]]'' Nintendo DS version</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The designers of the VT-49 Decimator have stated that the ship was created as an "evil" Imperial version of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://pc.ign.com/articles/557/557592p1.html|text=Jump to Lightspeed - The Ships of the Empire: We unveil two brand new ships.|work=IGN|date=2004-10-15|archivedate=20090123141636|nolive=1}}</ref> The sounds of the VT-49 Decimator were created by Lead Audio Designer [[Todd Davies]] using the ''Millennium Falcon'' as a reference.<ref>[[Star Wars Galaxies Bonus DVD|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Bonus DVD]] - ''Behind the scenes: Music and sound effects''</ref>
